cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Parietal bone
cards.label: A

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal, occipital, temporal, sphenoid and opposite parietal bone.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms much of the superior and lateral cranial vault.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Frontal bone
cards.label: B

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with parietal, sphenoid, ethmoid, nasal, maxillary, lacrimal and zygomatic bones.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms forehead, roofs of orbits and part of anterior cranial fossa.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasal bone
cards.label: C

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal bone, maxilla and opposite nasal bone.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the bony bridge of the nose.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ethmoid bone
cards.label: D

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal, sphenoid, vomer, nasal, maxillary, lacrimal, palatine bones and inferior nasal conchae.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Cribriform plate, crista galli, perpendicular plate and ethmoidal labyrinths.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Contributes to anterior cranial floor, nasal septum and medial orbital wall.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sphenoid bone
cards.label: E

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal, parietal, temporal, occipital, ethmoid, zygomatic, vomer and palatine bones.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, greater/lesser wings, pterygoid processes and sella turcica.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Central skull-base bone related to pituitary, orbit and cranial foramina.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Occipital bone
cards.label: F

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with parietal and temporal bones and atlas.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Foramen magnum, occipital condyles and external occipital protuberance.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms posterior cranial vault and much of posterior cranial fossa.
cards.label: F

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Maxilla
cards.label: G

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with multiple facial bones and contributes to hard palate, orbit and nasal cavity.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Alveolar process, palatine process, infraorbital foramen and maxillary sinus.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Houses upper teeth and forms much of the midface.
cards.label: G

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hard palate
cards.label: H

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Formed by palatine processes of maxillae anteriorly and horizontal plates of palatine bones posteriorly.
cards.label: H

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Separates oral and nasal cavities and provides a rigid surface for mastication and speech.
cards.label: H

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Nasal cavity lies superiorly and oral cavity inferiorly.
cards.label: H

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mandible
cards.label: I

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with temporal bones at temporomandibular joints.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, ramus, angle, coronoid process, condylar process, mental and mandibular foramina.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Supports lower teeth and provides major muscle attachments.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hyoid bone
cards.label: K

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Does not articulate directly with other bones; suspended by muscles and ligaments.
cards.label: K

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, greater horns and lesser horns.
cards.label: K

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Located in anterior neck around C3 level between mandible and thyroid cartilage.
cards.label: K

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Atlas
cards.label: L

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with occipital condyles superiorly and axis inferiorly.
cards.label: L

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Anterior/posterior arches, lateral masses and transverse foramina.
cards.label: L

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports skull and permits nodding at atlanto-occipital joints.
cards.label: L

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Axis
cards.label: M

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with atlas superiorly and C3 inferiorly.
cards.label: M

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Dens, body, bifid spinous process and transverse foramina.
cards.label: M

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Dens acts as pivot for rotation of atlas and head.
cards.label: M

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Frontal sinus
cards.label: a

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Within frontal bone above nasal root and orbits.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains to middle meatus via frontonasal pathway.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Close to anterior cranial fossa and orbit.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sphenoidal sinus
cards.label: b

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Within body of sphenoid bone.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains into sphenoethmoidal recess.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Pituitary lies superiorly; cavernous sinus and internal carotid arteries lie laterally.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Provides a transsphenoidal surgical route to the pituitary.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cerebrum
cards.label: A

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Responsible for higher cognition, conscious sensation, voluntary movement, language and behaviour.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Two cerebral hemispheres containing cortex, white matter and deep nuclei.
cards.label: A

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thalamus
cards.label: B

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Paired diencephalic structure forming much of the lateral wall of the third ventricle.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Major relay for sensory and motor information to the cerebral cortex, with roles in arousal and cognition.
cards.label: B

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Midbrain
cards.label: C

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Upper brainstem between diencephalon and pons.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains pathways and nuclei involved in eye movements, visual/auditory reflexes and motor control.
cards.label: C

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pons
cards.label: D

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Middle brainstem between midbrain and medulla.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains ascending/descending tracts and nuclei involved in facial sensation/movement, hearing, balance and respiratory modulation.
cards.label: D

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Medulla oblongata
cards.label: E

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior brainstem between pons and spinal cord.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains vital autonomic centres and pathways for cardiovascular, respiratory and reflex functions.
cards.label: E

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior sagittal sinus

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Runs in attached superior margin of falx cerebri.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains cerebral veins and CSF toward confluence of sinuses.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tentorium cerebelli

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Horizontal dural fold separating cerebellum from occipital lobes.

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Attaches to occipital bone, petrous temporal bone and sphenoid around the tentorial notch.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports occipital lobes and partitions posterior cranial fossa.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Corpus callosum; a) body, b) genu, c) splenium

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Major commissural fibre bundle connecting the cerebral hemispheres.

cards.question: Parts
cards.answer: Genu anteriorly, body centrally and splenium posteriorly.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Enables interhemispheric communication.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Anterior commissure

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small commissural fibre bundle crossing near anterior wall of third ventricle.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Connects temporal/olfactory-related regions across hemispheres.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Interthalamic adhesion

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Variable midline connection between medial surfaces of the thalami.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains little or no major commissural fibre function and may be absent.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Posterior commissure

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Commissural fibres crossing near posterior wall of third ventricle above cerebral aqueduct.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Important in bilateral pupillary light-reflex pathways.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Body of the fornix

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Paired white-matter tract beneath corpus callosum.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Major hippocampal output pathway toward mammillary bodies and septal regions.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Septum pellucidum

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Thin double membrane between corpus callosum and fornix.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Separates anterior horns of the lateral ventricles.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Medial thalamus

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Medial portion of thalamus forming part of lateral wall of third ventricle.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Participates in sensory, motor, limbic and cognitive relay functions.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pineal body or gland

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Posterior diencephalon attached to roof of third ventricle.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Secretes melatonin and contributes to circadian rhythm regulation.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pituitary gland or hypophysis

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: In hypophyseal fossa of sella turcica, connected to hypothalamus by infundibulum.

cards.question: Parts
cards.answer: Anterior pituitary and posterior pituitary.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Controls multiple endocrine axes.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Optic chiasm superior; sphenoidal sinus inferior; cavernous sinuses lateral.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mammillary body

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Small rounded hypothalamic structure on inferior brain surface.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Part of limbic memory circuitry; receives hippocampal input via fornix.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tectum of midbrain

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Dorsal midbrain containing superior and inferior colliculi.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Mediates visual and auditory orienting reflexes.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior (anterior) medullary velum

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Thin sheet of white matter forming part of roof of upper fourth ventricle.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Extends between superior cerebellar peduncles.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cerebellum

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Coordinates movement, balance, posture and motor learning.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Posterior to pons/medulla and inferior to tentorium cerebelli.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pons

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Brainstem between midbrain and medulla.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains relay nuclei, cranial nerve nuclei and major tracts; contributes to respiratory control.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Optic nerve (CN II)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Axons of retinal ganglion cells.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes from retina through optic canal to optic chiasm.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Vision and afferent limb of pupillary light reflex.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes ipsilateral monocular visual loss and an afferent pupillary defect.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Third ventricle

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Midline cavity of diencephalon between thalami.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Communicates with lateral ventricles via interventricular foramina and fourth ventricle via cerebral aqueduct.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains and conducts CSF.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Fourth ventricle

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Between pons/upper medulla and cerebellum.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Receives CSF from cerebral aqueduct and communicates with central canal/subarachnoid space.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contains and conducts CSF.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cerebral aqueduct (aqueduct of Sylvius)

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Narrow channel through midbrain.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Connects third and fourth ventricles.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Obstruction can cause non-communicating hydrocephalus.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Interventricular foramen

cards.question: Also called
cards.answer: Foramen of Monro.

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Connects each lateral ventricle with third ventricle.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Obstruction can enlarge one or both lateral ventricles.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Spinal cord

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Continuation of medulla through foramen magnum within vertebral canal.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Carries ascending sensory and descending motor pathways and mediates spinal reflexes.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Larynx

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains airway, protects lower respiratory tract during swallowing and produces phonation.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Anterior neck between pharynx and trachea, approximately C3–C6.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior nasal concha
cards.label: a

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Superior lateral nasal wall above superior meatus.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and turbulence for warming/humidifying inspired air.
cards.label: a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle nasal concha
cards.label: b

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lateral nasal wall above middle meatus.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and helps direct airflow around sinus drainage pathways.
cards.label: b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior nasal concha
cards.label: c

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior lateral nasal wall above inferior meatus.
cards.label: c

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and turbulence for air conditioning.
cards.label: c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Opening of auditory tube
cards.label: d

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lateral wall of nasopharynx.
cards.label: d

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Connects nasopharynx to middle ear and equalises pressure across tympanic membrane.
cards.label: d

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Salpingopharyngeal fold
cards.label: e

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mucosal fold over salpingopharyngeus descending from auditory-tube region.
cards.label: e

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Salpingopharyngeus elevates pharynx during swallowing and may assist tube opening.
cards.label: e

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Orbicularis oris muscle
cards.label: f

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Closes and protrudes lips; important in speech and oral competence.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII).
cards.label: f

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Complex fibres from maxilla, mandible and surrounding perioral muscles/modiolus.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Skin and mucosa of lips.
cards.label: f

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Incisor tooth
cards.label: g

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Cuts food during biting.
cards.label: g

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Crown with chisel-shaped edge and usually a single root.
cards.label: g

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Soft palate
cards.label: h

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Elevates during swallowing to close nasopharynx and contributes to speech.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Muscular fibrous fold extending posteriorly from hard palate.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Motor mainly via pharyngeal plexus except tensor veli palatini via V3; sensory via trigeminal pathways.
cards.label: h

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Uvula
cards.label: i

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Midline projection from posterior free margin of soft palate.
cards.label: i

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Moves with soft palate during swallowing and phonation.
cards.label: i

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tongue
cards.label: k

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Manipulates food, contributes to swallowing, taste and speech.
cards.label: k

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Motor via CN XII except palatoglossus via CN X; sensory/taste varies by region.
cards.label: k

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Foramen caecum
cards.label: l

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Small pit on dorsum of tongue at apex of sulcus terminalis.
cards.label: l

cards.question: Embryology
cards.answer: Marks embryological origin of thyroglossal duct and thyroid descent.
cards.label: l

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lingual septum
cards.label: m

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Midline fibrous partition within tongue.
cards.label: m

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Provides internal support and separates right/left tongue musculature.
cards.label: m

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Genioglossus muscle
cards.label: n

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Protrudes tongue and depresses its central part; unilateral action deviates tongue contralaterally.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).
cards.label: n

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Superior mental spine of mandible.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Tongue substance and body of hyoid.
cards.label: n

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Geniohyoid muscle
cards.label: o

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Pulls hyoid anterosuperiorly and assists mandibular depression.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: C1 fibres via hypoglossal nerve.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Inferior mental spine of mandible.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Body of hyoid.
cards.label: o

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mylohyoid muscle
cards.label: p

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Elevates floor of mouth and hyoid during swallowing; assists mandibular depression.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Nerve to mylohyoid from V3.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Mylohyoid line of mandible.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Median raphe and body of hyoid.
cards.label: p

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palatine tonsil
cards.label: q

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Tonsillar fossa between palatoglossal and palatopharyngeal arches.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Part of Waldeyer's ring; contributes to mucosal immune surveillance.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Tonsillar bed is vascular and glossopharyngeal nerve lies nearby.
cards.label: q

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Laryngopharynx
cards.label: r

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Posterior to larynx, from epiglottis/hyoid region to lower border of cricoid.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts food toward oesophagus and air toward laryngeal inlet.
cards.label: r

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Epiglottis
cards.label: I

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Leaf-shaped elastic cartilage forming part of laryngeal inlet.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps protect airway during swallowing by directing bolus away from laryngeal inlet.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Attached to thyroid cartilage and hyoid by ligaments.
cards.label: I

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyroid cartilage
cards.label: II

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Largest laryngeal cartilage formed by two laminae meeting anteriorly.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Protects vocal apparatus and provides muscular/ligamentous attachment.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Superior/inferior horns, oblique line and laryngeal prominence.
cards.label: II

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricoid cartilage
cards.label: III

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Complete ring of hyaline cartilage with narrow anterior arch and broad posterior lamina.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains airway and supports arytenoid cartilages.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Inferior to thyroid cartilage and superior to first tracheal ring.
cards.label: III

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Median thyrohyoid ligament
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Between superior border of thyroid cartilage and hyoid in midline.
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contributes to suspension of larynx from hyoid.
cards.label: IV

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricothyroid ligament
cards.label: V

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects cricoid and thyroid cartilages.
cards.label: V

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Stabilises laryngeal framework.
cards.label: V

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Site used for emergency cricothyrotomy.
cards.label: V

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Transverse arytenoid muscles
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Adduct arytenoid cartilages and close posterior rima glottidis.
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent laryngeal nerve (CN X).
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Posterior surface of one arytenoid cartilage.
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Posterior surface of opposite arytenoid cartilage.
cards.label: VI

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vocal fold
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mucosal fold containing vocal ligament and vocalis muscle.
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Vibrates for phonation and closes glottis for airway protection.
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Intrinsic laryngeal motor control mainly via recurrent laryngeal nerve; sensory below fold via recurrent laryngeal nerve.
cards.label: VII

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vestibular fold
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Superior mucosal fold containing vestibular ligament.
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps protect airway and contributes to laryngeal closure.
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Lies superior to true vocal fold.
cards.label: VIII

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ventricle of the larynx
cards.label: IX

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Recess between vestibular fold and vocal fold.
cards.label: IX

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Allows independent movement of folds and communicates with laryngeal saccule.
cards.label: IX

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Trachea
cards.label: X

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Conducts air between larynx and bronchi.
cards.label: X

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Fibrocartilaginous tube supported by C-shaped hyaline cartilage rings and posterior trachealis muscle.
cards.label: X

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Begins below cricoid cartilage around C6 and descends into thorax.
cards.label: X

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Occipitofrontalis muscle (frontal belly)
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Elevates eyebrows and wrinkles forehead.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII), temporal branches.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Epicranial aponeurosis.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Skin of forehead and eyebrows.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Occipitofrontalis muscle (occipital belly)
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Retracts scalp.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII), posterior auricular branch.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Lateral superior nuchal line and mastoid region.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Epicranial aponeurosis.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Orbicularis oculi muscle
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Closes eyelids; orbital part closes tightly, palpebral part gently.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII).
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Medial orbital margin, medial palpebral ligament and lacrimal bone.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Skin around orbit and tarsal plates/lateral palpebral raphe.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palpebral part of orbicularis oculi muscle
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Gently closes eyelids during blinking and sleep.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII).
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Medial palpebral ligament/lacrimal region.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Lateral palpebral raphe.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasalis muscle
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Compresses or dilates the nasal aperture depending on part.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Facial nerve (CN VII).
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Maxilla.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Nasal cartilage and aponeurosis over bridge.
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Levator labii superioris alaeque nasi muscle
cards.section: Musculature of the head and neck

cards.question: Actions

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Common carotid artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Right from brachiocephalic trunk; left from aortic arch.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends in carotid sheath and bifurcates near upper border of thyroid cartilage.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Terminates as external and internal carotid arteries.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Head and neck through external and internal carotid systems.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: External carotid artery
cards.label: 58a

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Terminal branch of common carotid artery.
cards.label: 58a

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends through carotid triangle, passes deep to posterior belly of digastric and enters parotid gland.
cards.label: 58a

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Superior thyroid, ascending pharyngeal, lingual, facial, occipital, posterior auricular, maxillary and superficial temporal arteries.
cards.label: 58a

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Most extracranial structures of head and neck.
cards.label: 58a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Internal carotid artery
cards.label: 58b

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Terminal branch of common carotid artery.
cards.label: 58b

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends in carotid sheath without branching in neck, enters carotid canal and continues intracranially.
cards.label: 58b

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Major arterial supply to brain and orbit.
cards.label: 58b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior thyroid artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Usually first anterior branch of external carotid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Descends toward superior pole of thyroid.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Thyroid gland and nearby laryngeal/infrahyoid structures.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lingual artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: External carotid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes deep to hyoglossus toward tongue.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Tongue and floor of mouth.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Facial artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: External carotid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes deep to submandibular gland, hooks around inferior mandible anterior to masseter and ascends across face.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Face, lips, nose, submandibular region and tonsillar/palatal areas.

cards.question: Note
cards.answer: The label can resemble the number 67 on the model; identify the vessel by position rather than numeral shape.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Transverse facial artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Usually branch of superficial temporal artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Runs horizontally across face superficial to masseter below zygomatic arch.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Parotid region, masseter and lateral face.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superficial temporal artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Terminal branch of external carotid artery within parotid gland.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends anterior to ear over zygomatic arch into scalp.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Lateral scalp and temporal region.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Posterior auricular artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: External carotid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends posterior to auricle.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Auricle and scalp posterior to ear.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Occipital artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: External carotid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes posteriorly deep to posterior belly of digastric toward occipital scalp.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Posterior scalp and deep neck structures.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Facial nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Motor nucleus in pons with sensory/parasympathetic fibres in nervus intermedius.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Enters internal acoustic meatus, traverses facial canal, exits stylomastoid foramen and branches in parotid gland.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies muscles of facial expression, stapedius, stylohyoid and posterior belly of digastric.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Taste from anterior two-thirds of tongue; small external-ear sensory component.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lower motor neuron lesion causes ipsilateral weakness of upper and lower facial muscles; other deficits depend on lesion level.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Anterior auricular nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Usually auriculotemporal nerve distribution from V3 around anterior auricle/temporal region.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Runs anterior to auricle in temporal region.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: No motor function.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies sensation to anterior auricle, external acoustic meatus region and temporal scalp.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes localised sensory loss or paraesthesia anterior to the auricle/temporal region without motor deficit.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Zygomatic branch of the facial nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Terminal motor branch of facial nerve within parotid plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes across zygomatic region toward orbicularis oculi and adjacent facial muscles.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies muscles around the lateral orbit and upper cheek, especially orbicularis oculi.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: No meaningful cutaneous sensory territory.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes weakness of facial-expression muscles in its distribution, especially impaired eye closure if orbicularis oculi supply is affected.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Buccal branch of the facial nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Terminal motor branch of facial nerve within parotid plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Runs across masseter toward cheek and upper lip.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies buccinator and muscles of upper lip/nose region.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: No meaningful cutaneous sensory territory.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes weakness of cheek compression and facial-expression muscles in the midface, potentially causing food to collect in the vestibule.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Marginal mandibular branch of the facial nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Terminal motor branch of facial nerve.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Runs near inferior border of mandible toward lower lip/chin.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies depressor anguli oris, depressor labii inferioris and mentalis.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: No meaningful cutaneous sensory territory.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes asymmetry of lower lip, especially on smiling or showing teeth.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Posterior auricular nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Branch of facial nerve shortly after stylomastoid foramen.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends behind auricle.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies posterior auricular muscles and occipital belly of occipitofrontalis.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: No significant cutaneous sensory distribution.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes weakness of posterior auricular muscles and occipital belly, usually subtle clinically.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Great auricular nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: C2–C3 from cervical plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Emerges at posterior border of SCM and ascends over it toward parotid/auricle.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: No motor function.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies skin over parotid region, mastoid region, angle of mandible and much of lower auricle.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes numbness or paraesthesia over lower auricle, parotid region and angle of mandible.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lesser occipital nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: C2, sometimes C3, from cervical plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends along posterior border of SCM toward scalp behind ear.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: No motor function.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies skin of lateral occipital scalp and upper medial auricle.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes sensory loss or neuralgic pain over lateral occiput behind the ear.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Greater occipital nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Medial branch of posterior ramus of C2.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Emerges beneath suboccipital muscles and ascends with occipital artery to posterior scalp.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Motor fibres to some deep neck muscles via parent ramus; named cutaneous branch is mainly sensory.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies posterior scalp up to vertex.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion/irritation can cause occipital neuralgia with pain or altered sensation over posterior scalp.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Transverse cervical nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: C2–C3 from cervical plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Emerges at posterior border of SCM and crosses horizontally over its surface.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: No motor function.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies skin of anterior and lateral neck.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes numbness or paraesthesia over anterior/lateral neck.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Supraclavicular nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: C3–C4 from cervical plexus.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Descends from posterior border of SCM and divides into medial, intermediate and lateral branches.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: No motor function.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Supplies skin over clavicle, upper chest and shoulder.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes sensory loss or paraesthesia over clavicular/upper thoracic/shoulder skin.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Accessory nerve (CN XI)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Spinal rootlets from upper cervical cord, classically C1–C5/6.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Ascends through foramen magnum, exits jugular foramen, crosses posterior triangle to trapezius.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies sternocleidomastoid and trapezius.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: No cutaneous sensory function.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lesion causes weak head turning away from affected side and ipsilateral shoulder droop/weak shrug.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: External ear

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Includes auricle and external acoustic meatus up to the tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Collects and conducts sound toward the tympanic membrane.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Sensory supply derives from auriculotemporal, great auricular, lesser occipital and vagal contributions depending on region.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Parotid gland

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Produces serous saliva.

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Parotid bed between ramus of mandible and mastoid/SCM region.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Parotid duct crosses masseter, pierces buccinator and opens opposite upper second molar.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Parasympathetic secretomotor pathway from CN IX via lesser petrosal nerve, otic ganglion and auriculotemporal nerve.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Facial nerve, retromandibular vein and external carotid artery traverse the gland.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Zygomatic bone

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal, sphenoid, temporal and maxillary bones.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms cheek prominence and contributes to lateral orbital wall and floor.

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Frontal, temporal and maxillary processes and zygomaticofacial foramen.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hyoid bone

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Does not articulate directly with other bones; suspended by muscles and ligaments.

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, greater horns and lesser horns.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Located in anterior neck around C3 between mandible and thyroid cartilage.
